content: NATS messaging for IIoT: lightweight, high-performance pub/sub system. Supports multiple language clients (Go, Python). Embedded mode possible for edge devices. Used as internal bus for decoupled component communication. Patterns: subject-based messaging, request-reply for synchronous operations, queue groups for load balancing.适合 microkernel architecture where core and plugins need loose coupling. Store-and-forward not native but can be built on top.
